description: The friendly tool for writing game dialogue in Rust

latest_release.name: v0.10.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Replace FiraMono font license with text. by @eswartz in https://github.com/YarnSpinnerTool/YarnSpinner-Rust/pull/287
* Use `crossterm::event::poll` to avoid blank screen between choices. by @eswartz in https://github.com/YarnSpinnerTool/YarnSpinner-Rust/pull/286
* Bevy 0.20 by @tcanabrava in https://github.com/YarnSpinnerTool/YarnSpinner-Rust/pull/289
* Log an error when an unknown `<<command>>` is used in Bevy. by @eswartz in https://github.com/YarnSpinnerTool/YarnSpinner-Rust/pull/290
* bevy: Fix relative asset root bug by @ada-x64 in https://github.com/YarnSpinnerTool/YarnSpinner-Rust/pull/291

## New Contributors
* @eswartz made their first contribution in https://github.com/YarnSpinnerTool/YarnSpinner-Rust/pull/287
* @tcanabrava made their first contribution in https://github.com/YarnSpinnerTool/YarnSpinner-Rust/pull/289
* @ada-x64 made their first contribution in https://github.com/YarnSpinnerTool/YarnSpinner-Rust/pull/291

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/YarnSpinnerTool/YarnSpinner-Rust/compare/v0.9.0...v0.10.0
